our tests are more powerful for the same type of alternatives and that our tests can also be used to detect more general alternatives.

the new tests based on the characteristic function are asymptotically valid under the null hypothesis of copula symmetry, and they are more powerful than their competitors based on the empirical version of the empirical copula.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the characteristic function of the copula provides a convenient and powerful alternative to the empirical copula in the context of testing symmetry.
characteristic functions can be used to test symmetry of copulas and this is illustrated by means of a real data set.
the copula characteristic functions are a powerful tool to test symmetry of a dependence between two random variables.
